decisions.decision: Dennis told the students the group would have to check insurance with the Town Manager.
decisions.quote: they asked about insurance and dennis told them we would have to check with town manager.

decisions.decision: If Marshall Park becomes the students' first choice, the commission would bring them back and include the Town Manager, DPW Director and Police Chief in the discussion.
decisions.quote: dennis told them if marshall park emerges as their number 1 choice, we would have them back and include the town manager

decisions.decision: Karin would submit the Seasonal Certification form to Nancy using the Friday before Memorial Day through the third Thursday of September, so the Beach Coordinator can give a wrap-up of the 2018 season.
decisions.quote: karin said she would submit the form to nancy using the friday before memorial day through the third

decisions.decision: The 2018 season beach pass fees were to be added to the April agenda.
decisions.quote: karin mentioned that the commission needed to look at the 2018 season fees for beach passes and would like that added to the april agenda.

decisions.decision: Town Counsel's recommendation to continue the status quo from last season was noted; any request for use would come through Parks.
decisions.quote: karin said that would mean that any request for use would need to come through parks.

decisions.decision: Karin would ask Chris Letarte for a final playground design plan and then set up a commission meeting; Dennis wants to see the plan and have Jack review it before a final OK.
decisions.quote: karin will go back to chris letarte and request he get a final design plan and then set up a commission meeting.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set for March 15, 2018, with a second March meeting to finalize the playground design if needed.
decisions.quote: upcoming meeting - march 15, 2018 and a second march meeting to finalize playground design if needed.
